notes: Release candidate for version 1.0.
A new look: the sidebar and banners are a night sky lit by the aurora.
The Library opens with a banner showing what's installed and ready to update, and a "What's new" row with the latest notes from each app.
App pages have screenshots. Click one to see it full-size, and use the arrow keys or the buttons to go through them.
A short welcome the first time the Launcher opens: choose where apps are installed and whether updates install by themselves.
CJ Philip Community is marked as an optional download.
Settings and the saved catalogue are read more carefully, and an unrecoverable error now shows a message with a saved report.
CJ Radio is no longer listed here: it's installed, updated and opened from CJ Philip Community, which NorthRay Launcher still installs.

Maintenance release: CJ Philip Community now opens NorthRay Launcher to get or update CJ apps.
No scroll bars: the faint bar that showed while scrolling is gone too.
Smoother animations: eased page changes, status messages that fade in and out, and softer hover effects.
Download progress bars glide smoothly, and app rows lift on hover.
Reads the app catalogue from the NorthRay website.
Subtle animations, and hidden scroll bars.
NorthRay Launcher replaces the CJ Community launcher as the central app manager.
Downloads apps over HTTPS with a progress bar, checks each installer's size and SHA-256, then installs it silently.
Update detection, Update all, and optional automatic updates (off by default).
Choose where new apps are installed; apps installed elsewhere are still found.
Takes over installs from the older CJ Community setup.
